pool.text: Despot Andronikos Palaiologos ceded the city to the Republic of Venice.
The Ottomans conquered the city and remained there for nearly five centuries.
The Ottomans took control of Thessaloniki after a lengthy siege of the city.
The Greek War of Independence broke out in the spring.
Regular Ottoman soldiers attacked and destroyed the Janissary base.
Benrubis founded one of the first retail companies in the Balkans.
The AVEZ pasta industry was built as an early industrial factory.
The Thessaloniki International Exhibition Centre was first established in this year.
A massive strike by tobacco workers led to general anarchy.
The city fell to the forces of Nazi Germany.
The first resistance organization in Greece was founded in Eptalofos.
The Nazis began the deportation of the city's Jews to concentration camps.
The Nazis began deportation of the historic Jewish population to concentration camps.
Forces of ELAS entered Thessaloniki as liberators headed by Markos Vafiadis.
Frappé was invented in the Thessaloniki International Fair and spread throughout Greece.
The Thessaloniki International Film Festival was established as an important film festival.
The National Theatre of Northern Greece was established to run the city main theaters.
The Archaeological Museum of Thessaloniki was established to house ancient artifacts.
Grigoris Lambrakis was assassinated by two far-right extremists driving a vehicle.
The city suffered a series of powerful earthquakes registering 5.5 and 6.5.
